Inlined native Toggle: web role='switch' button (track) + white sliding thumb + optional right-hand label -> a Pressable (accessibilityRole='switch', accessibilityState={checked}, accessibilityLabel=label) wrapping a track View that tints colors.accent when checked / a muted slate when off, with an absolutely-positioned white thumb at the web sm geometry (h-5 w-9 track / h-3.5 thumb / translate-x-4 on inset 3px); RN has no CSS transition so the thumb is positioned at its off/on offset directly. Inlined native DataTable (subset): a header row of column headers + one body row per datum rendered through each column's render(); compact tightens the vertical padding and pagination slices at the page size with a Prev/Next pager shown only when totalPages>1, the page resetting to 1 on row-count change. The local Column<T> ({key,header,render}) matches the props this caller supplies.

No DOM elements, react-i18next, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output — only React, RN primitives (Platform/Pressable/StyleSheet/View + StyleProp/TextStyle/ViewStyle types), the already-ported native Skeleton/FadeIn, and the shared apps/native AppText/GlassPanel + theme tokens (colors/spacing). SI/unit contract is untouched: the panel formats already-numeric SignalStat values and introduces no mi/min/mph/kwh/kw/psi suffixes or conversions.
